description: Fetch high-resolution App Store screenshots. Directory shots return 3 screenshots without Library Pro. The rest of the listing is $19 a month. Pass live=true to look up the current App Store listing of the user's own app (API key required). Use get_directory_app when you already have a catalog slug.

live.description: Skip the directory and fetch the current App Store listing.

query.description: App name to search in the directory, then the App Store.

slug.description: Directory slug. Returns catalog screens without a live App Store lookup.

name: get_screenshots
title: Get screenshots
